5. CONFOUNDERS: The trial was terminated early due to a pre-specified DSMB-triggered stopping rule based on mortality imbalance (33 vs 56 deaths, HR 0.58). Early termination can inflate effect estimates, but the mortality benefit was the pre-specified secondary endpoint and the cognitive benefit was also significant. The cardiac failure SAE rate was higher in galantamine (0.98% vs 0.29%), which is a safety signal worth noting but did not prevent adequate dosing or drive termination. The trial was large (N=2051) and adequately powered. The MMSE effect size (+0.73 points) is modest but statistically robust and consistent with the known class effect. Overall, this is a genuine success with the caveat of early termination potentially inflating the mortality HR estimate.
